text: {"established":["The stage-1 candidate [-248,-10,-259,74,105,338] received a public_pass receipt with 19 checks.","At stage 2, the submitted candidate [-343,24,18,-101,-24,426] received a public_mismatch on check “balance-0.” The feedback says it violates a released requirement and supplies no replacement answer."],"retained_observations":["The candidate note says balances were recomputed using the highest revision per transaction across released packets.","The task rules say revisions replace a whole transaction; select the largest revision, breaking ties by largest sequence, ignore the selected transaction if void, and recompute balances using all released packets at each stage.","The public dossier contains stage-1 and stage-2 packets, and earlier packets remain relevant."],"uncertainties":["The feedback does not provide the required balance or identify the cause of the mismatch.","The mismatch does not establish that the reconciliation method as a whole is invalid; it only establishes that this candidate failed the named check."]}
